vmInstanceId.description:
Id of the instance in the cloud (aws instance id, etc). This field uniquely scpecifies an instance,
so no other field value is needed.

nodeId.description: C3 node Id of the instance. This field uniquely specifies an instance, so no other field value is needed.

hostName.description:
Hostname of the instance. If it is a FQDN it uniquely specifies an instance, so no other field value is needed.
If it is not fully qualified either 'domain' or vmVpcId have to also be specified.

ip.description: Typically a private IP address, so it requires either 'domain' or vmVpcId to also be specified.

domain.description: Network domain of the target instance.

vmVpcId.description:
Id of the instance's VPC.

If specified, this bastion will be used to reach the target instance.

title:
Type that uniquely describes a server instance in the cloud as a target for an ssh driven command.

One of the following field combinations is required to consider an SshEndPoint to be valid:

* _nodeId_
* fully qualified _hostName_
* _vmInstanceId_
* _hostName_ and _domain_
* _hostName_ and _vmVpcId_
* _ip_ and _domain_
* _ip_ and _vmVpcId_

For example, all the following SshEndPoints are valid and fully specify a target:

* SshEndPoint.make({"nodeId":"dev-podz-app-m-02.c3-vpc.internal"})
* SshEndPoint.make({"hostName":"dev-podz-app-m-02.c3-vpc.internal"})
* SshEndPoint.make({"vmInstanceId":"i-eefc5705"})
* SshEndPoint.make({"hostName":"dev-podz-app-m-02","domain":"c3-vpc.internal"})
* SshEndPoint.make({"hostName":"dev-podz-app-m-02","vmVpcId":"vpc-cfb379a3"})
* SshEndPoint.make({"ip":"10.0.2.191","domain":"c3-vpc.internal"})
* SshEndPoint.make({"ip":"10.0.2.191","vmVpcId":"vpc-cfb379a3"})
name: SshEndPoint
